q: The Morse sequence (0 1 1 0 1 0 0 1 …) generated by the substitution 0↦01, 1↦10 is a fixed point of the substitution and serves as an example of:
opts: A minimal, almost periodic sequence that is not periodic
exp: The Thue-Morse sequence (Morse sequence) is uniformly recurrent (almost periodic) and minimal but not periodic. Its complexity function p(n) = O(n), entropy 0, and it arises naturally in number theory and combinatorics on words.
